company.name: Magazino – a Jungheinrich company
company.tagline: Mobile picking robots for ecommerce and production supply
company.description:
Magazino - a Jungheinrich company - develops and builds intelligent, mobile robots that automate intralogistics. The robots perceive their environment, make their own decisions, grasp and/or move pallets or bins. Our autonomous robots work in parallel to humans and make processes in the areas of production logistics more flexible and efficient. With 160+ employees at its Munich site, Magazino as the robot-development unit of Jungheinrich is one of the largest advanced robotics teams in Europe. 

Become part of an award-winning company and get more information about open job positions on our website www.magazino.eu.
